horizon-dock-modular-3-in-1-wireless-cha.description: A desk station that pairs a storage bin with a sliding charging bridge: the top plate moves across the base so you can position a 57 mm MagSafe puck where the phone lands, with room below for keys, cards and cables. Charger not included. STL and 3MF on Cults3D and Thangs.

modular-glasses-storage-drawer-stackable.description: A stackable drawer system for glasses: each module interlocks with the one below into a solid tower — no clips or hardware — and every pair gets its own closed slot away from scratches. Prints without supports. Files on Cults3D and Thangs.

fidget-rolling-marble-pen-holder-spiral-.description: A pen pot wrapped in a spiral marble run: drop a marble at the top and watch it wind down to the basin while you think. Optimised to print cleanly without supports. Marbles not included. STL and 3MF on Cults3D and Thangs.

terraflora-modular-tiered-planter-system.description: A stepped, modular planter grid that raises each pot to a different height so a tall plant does not shade the smaller ones. A tray underneath catches run-off. Prints without supports. STL and 3MF on Cults3D and Thangs.

ikea-skadis-pegboard-plant-pot-holder-mi.description: A two-piece planter that drops onto an official SKÅDIS pegboard on built-in hooks — no glue, screws or extra hardware. The tapered inner pot slides out for planting and watering. Prints without supports. Files on Cults3D and Thangs.
